latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Fasting Tracker.

- Start and track fasting sessions with real-time timers and milestone countdowns
- Log eating windows and automatically calculate fast durations
- Get alerts for metabolic milestones: ketosis (12h), fat adaptation (16h), autophagy (24h), and advanced phases
- View fast history with duration, consistency, and streak metrics
- Customize fasting protocols, schedules, and notification reminders
- All data remains private and stored locally on your device
